Mamie Durham

Preserved Primary Document • durhm-m2.htm

Mamie Durham Morgan Mamie Durham was born in Kent Co., Delaware on 17 December, 1897. She was the daughter of Enoch Durham and Margaret Munce. In 1918, Mamie gave birth to a son: Norris Edward Durham (1918-1998). He was raised by Mamie's brother, Wilson Durham. Mamie later married Edward Morgan and moved to Fairton, Salem Co., NJ. After nursing her sister, Maybelle Durham, Mamie developed TB and was sent to the Fairview Sanitarium in Burlington Co., NJ where she died on 31 October, 1929. Her death certificate lists her birthdate as " Dec. 17, 1897", her race as "colored" and the cause of death as "pulmonary tuberculosis". Unbeknownst to Mamie, her daughter Naomi also developed TB and died a few days after her mother. Mother and daughter are both buried in the same grave at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold , DE
